source_policy.trade_date_rule: Latest completed U.S. cash session is 2026-09-03. Taiwan FX latest completed official close is 2026-09-03. TAIFEX after-hours physical window 2026-09-03 15:00–2026-09-04 05:00 is attributed to session_trade_date 2026-09-04.
source_policy.uncertainty_rule: When exact same-session data are not independently verified, retain null and flag validation_required. Different-date observations must never be blended.

breaking_news.headline: Waller signals support for holding rates steady if inflation eases
breaking_news.summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said he could support keeping rates unchanged if inflation pressures ease. U.S. equities rallied and Treasury yields fell.
breaking_news.market_impact: Reduced immediate rate-hike fear; Nasdaq led as duration-sensitive growth recovered.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Positive for AI/semiconductor valuation multiples if Friday payrolls do not reignite yield pressure.

breaking_news.headline: NVIDIA agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.93B
breaking_news.summary: NVIDIA agreed to acquire open-source AI platform Hugging Face for about $12.93B while keeping the platform open and not requiring NVIDIA chips.
breaking_news.market_impact: Extends NVIDIA from GPU hardware deeper into the developer/model distribution layer.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Strategically positive for the NVIDIA ecosystem and long-run AI infrastructure demand; near-term direct Taiwan hardware impact is indirect.

breaking_news.headline: Solvay doubles Taiwan ultra-pure hydrogen peroxide capacity
breaking_news.summary: Solvay plans to lift Taiwan ultra-pure hydrogen peroxide capacity from 35,000 to more than 70,000 tonnes by end-2026, citing advanced-node and AI-chip demand including TSMC's 3nm ecosystem.
breaking_news.market_impact: Confirms leading-edge semiconductor materials demand remains robust.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Positive signal for advanced-node fab utilization and semiconductor materials supply chain.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. services strengthen but prices remain elevated
breaking_news.summary: ISM Services PMI rose to 55.4 from 54.1; new orders strengthened while prices paid reached 72.6 and employment remained contractionary at 47.8.
breaking_news.market_impact: Growth is resilient but inflation pressure remains, making Friday payrolls decisive for Fed pricing.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Stronger U.S. demand supports tech exports, while high service inflation caps valuation expansion.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. July trade deficit widens 24.4% to $88.6B
breaking_news.summary: Imports rose 2.8% to $399.3B, led by record capital-goods imports including computers and semiconductors; exports fell 2.1% to $310.7B.
breaking_news.market_impact: Potential Q3 GDP drag, but record capital-goods imports reinforce AI investment intensity.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Constructive read-through for semiconductor and AI hardware demand despite macro GDP drag.

breaking_news.headline: Snowflake surges after stronger AI-driven outlook; Broadcom falls despite strong AI sales
breaking_news.summary: Snowflake gained about 16.6% on a stronger annual product-revenue outlook, while Broadcom fell about 2.7% as a slightly soft top-line guide overshadowed strong AI-chip demand.
breaking_news.market_impact: AI spending is broadening from hardware into data/software, but valuation hurdles remain extreme.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Supports cloud/data-center infrastructure demand while warning that strong AI fundamentals alone may not guarantee positive stock reaction.

breaking_news.headline: Zscaler and Samsara beat and raise/guide strongly
breaking_news.summary: Zscaler reported $898.2M revenue and adjusted EPS $1.19; Samsara reported $508.4M revenue, adjusted EPS $0.20 and raised full-year revenue guidance to about $2.043-$2.047B.
breaking_news.market_impact: Further evidence enterprise AI/software and connected-operations spending remain healthy.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Indirectly supportive of cloud/data-center and enterprise infrastructure demand.

narration_points: 美股在 Waller 暗示若通膨降溫可支持暫停升息後全面反彈，Nasdaq +1.40% 領漲，10 年債殖利率回落約 3.6bp。
NVIDIA +1.8%，並以約 129.3 億美元收購 Hugging Face，AI 主線從 GPU 硬體進一步延伸到開源模型與開發者平台。
SOX 僅小漲約 0.22%，TSM ADR 約小漲，AMD微跌，顯示半導體內部仍是分化而非全面主升。
黃金期貨大漲約 2.8%，美元指數轉弱；WTI 仍站 91 美元上方，中東供應風險尚未消失。
ISM 服務業 55.4 顯示需求強，但 prices paid 72.6 代表通膨壓力仍高，今晚非農是利率方向最關鍵驗證。
台股 9/3 日盤走弱、外資期貨淨空仍達 -81,575 口；9/4 歸屬夜盤盤中曾強彈，但最終 05:00 官方收盤尚待同 session 驗證。
